==Biography==
Originally a solo queue midlaner, Minerva was known for his support play, especially when using {{ci|Thresh}}. [[Minerva]] played midlane with a common team under several different organizations. When [[PaiN Gaming]] released Espeon after [[Gamescom 2013]] Wildcard Tournament, Minerva started to duo queue with [[BrTT]] and soon he joined the team as the new support. Despite not having much experience playing support, Minerva's play contributed to PaiN's success while he was a member of the team.
In May 2014, Minerva left paiN and joined [[KaBuM! e-Sports]] as their starting AD carry, replacing [[dans]] in that role; dans moved to support and [[Espeon]] was moved to substitute. With KaBuM!, Minerva participated in the [[2014 Season World Championship]], and though the team placed last in their group, they notably beat [[Alliance]] in one game. Minerva's {{ci|Jinx}} play was a large contributing factor to their success in that victory.
On October 31, 2014, Minerva announced that he was stepping down from KaBuM!, not retiring but taking some time off.<ref>[http://www.facebook.com/LoLMinerva/photos/714735438574318 Minerva's Facebook]</ref><ref>[http://leagueofbrazil.wordpress.com/2014/10/31/minerva-is-no-longer-member-of-kabum/ Minerva is no longer member of KaBuM] ''leagueofbrazil.wordpress.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Necro once said in a interview that '''Minerva''' would be an excellent support due to his aggressiveness and mechanics.
* Before [[paiN Gaming]], [[Minerva]] played in the midlane.
* Favorite midlane champions are {{ci|LeBlanc}} and {{ci|Syndra}}.
* Brazilian casters used to say that "Minerva left the mid lane, but the mid lane didn't leave him" because of his high KDA on supports.
* He's openly homosexual.
* His favorite supports are {{ci|Thresh}} and {{ci|Sona}}.
* After playing as mid laner, support and AD carry, he moved to the jungle during the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2|CBLOL Split 2 2015]].
* Portrayed as {{ci|Fizz}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* Is known for his {{ci|graves}} performance in [[BRCC 2019 Split 1]] where he got a 6 level advantage against [[Operation Kino e-Sports]] jungler at the time.<ref>[https://ibb.co/YQndvz1 Minerva's Graves] ''imgbb.com''</ref>
* His '''Kings Lendas''' team name comes from a pun with [[G2]] and his {{ci|viego}} winrate in competitive.
